name: Business Current Account Opening — Event Catalogue
description: Authoritative catalogue of all domain events published during JRN-004. Events are the mechanism for cross-capability state propagation (SVC-102 event bus). Each event entry specifies: owning service, source entity, trigger condition, journey phase, payload schema, consuming services with action descriptions, ordering guarantees, topic, data classification, WORM audit pipeline flag, capability scope, and CloudEvents type. All events follow the past-tense domain event naming convention.
catalogue_principles: Every event name is in past tense: the event records a fact that has occurred.
Payload schemas carry the minimum data required for consumers to act. Raw PII (document images, biometric scores, full document numbers) are never included in event payloads.
All events tagged data_classification: pii or data_classification: financial are routed to the WORM audit pipeline (SVC-111).
Intra-capability events are consumed only by services within the same capability domain. Cross-capability events cross at least one capability boundary.
Ordering guarantees apply at the event bus (SVC-102) level. The partition key determines per-key ordering — all events for a given business_customer_id are strictly ordered within a topic partition.

Tipping-off prohibition (POCA 2002 s333A) is a functional constraint on these events: CDD outcomes, PEP matches, and sanctions hits must never be included in event payloads visible to PER-002 or PER-050.

events.name: BusinessApplicationStarted
events.trigger: PER-002 submits the business account application form. SVC-017 calls SVC-005 to create BusinessCustomer (prospect) and BusinessApplicationRecord with status = in_progress. BusinessApplicationStarted is published immediately on successful creation.
events.capability_scope_rationale: Published by CAP-002 (Commercial Banking / SVC-005); consumed by CAP-005 (SVC-050 — initialises onboarding case) and CAP-007 (SVC-017 — initialises application UI).

payload_schema.business_customer_id: string (UUID v4) — BusinessCustomer prospect record identifier
payload_schema.company_number: string — Companies House registration number (or null for sole traders)
payload_schema.entity_type: string enum (limited_company | llp | partnership | sole_trader | charity | other)

consumers.action: Initialises the application flow UI and displays the provisional application reference (BCA-YYYY-XXXXX) to PER-002
Initialises the business onboarding case. No identity verification sessions are created yet — sessions are created after UBO identification completes (PH-141)
Creates immutable audit log entry for the application initiation event
Immutably archives the event for MLR 2017 Regulation 40 record-keeping (5-year minimum retention)

events.ordering_guarantees: Per-business-customer strict ordering via business_customer_id partition key on topic commercial.applications.
events.worm_rationale: Contains business_customer_id and company_number. MLR 2017 Regulation 40 requires records of application initiation to be retained for 5 years post-application.

events.name: CompaniesHouseVerified
events.trigger: SVC-005 successfully calls the Companies House API at PH-140 and reconciles the returned company data with the applicant's submitted details. Company status = active, legal name matches within threshold. DirectorRecord and UBO staging entities have been created from CH officer and PSC data.
events.capability_scope_rationale: Published by CAP-002 (SVC-005); consumed by CAP-005 (SVC-014 — uses company details as CDD inputs) and CAP-007 (SVC-017 — renders verification confirmation to PER-002).

payload_schema.legal_name: string — verified legal name from Companies House
payload_schema.country_of_incorporation: string (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2) — always GB for this event
payload_schema.director_count: integer — number of DirectorRecord entities created
payload_schema.ubo_count_from_psc: integer — number of natural person PSC entries (UBO staging count)
payload_schema.corporate_psc_detected: boolean — true if any PSC is a legal entity (triggers look-through requirement)

consumers.action: Receives company details (legal name, SIC codes, incorporation date, operating countries) as inputs for company-level CDD screening at PH-143. Sector risk and jurisdictional risk assessment begins on receipt.
Renders the Companies House verification confirmation screen to PER-002 with verified company details
Immutable audit log entry — records that CH verification was performed and the outcome

events.ordering_guarantees: Strictly ordered after BusinessApplicationStarted for the same business_customer_id.
events.worm_rationale: Companies House verification is an MLR 2017 Regulation 28(11) compliance step. The verification record must be retained for 5 years per MLR 2017 Regulation 40.

events.name: UBOIdentified
events.trigger: Each UltimateBeneficialOwner entity is created and confirmed by the applicant at PH-141. One UBOIdentified event is published per natural person UBO. Events are published in batch after the applicant submits the confirmed UBO list.
events.capability_scope_rationale: Published by CAP-002 (SVC-005); consumed by CAP-005 (SVC-050 — creates verification sessions; SVC-014 — queues individual screening). Cross-capability: commercial → compliance.

payload_schema.ubo_first_name: string — from Companies House PSC or applicant declaration
payload_schema.verification_invitation_sent: boolean — true if an email invitation has been dispatched

consumers.action: Creates an identity verification session for this UBO. If the UBO is the primary applicant, their session is activated immediately in-app. Otherwise, a secure email invitation is dispatched.
Registers this UBO in the PH-143 screening queue. Prepares to run PEP/sanctions/adverse media screening once the individual's identity verification is confirmed via DirectorVerified event.
Immutable audit log entry for UBO identification — MLR 2017 Regulation 40 compliance

events.ordering_guarantees: Strictly ordered after CompaniesHouseVerified for the same business_customer_id. Multiple UBOIdentified events may be published per application — each is independently ordered within the partition.
events.worm_rationale: UBO identification is a core MLR 2017 Regulation 28(3)(a) compliance obligation. The identification record must be retained for 5 years post-relationship end per MLR 2017 Regulation 40.
events.retention: 5 years post-relationship end (WORM audit pipeline — SVC-111)

events.name: DirectorVerified
events.trigger: SVC-050 receives a terminal pass outcome from the identity verification vendor (Onfido/Jumio) for a director or UBO individual. One DirectorVerified event is published per individual on pass. Each individual's session is independent — events are published asynchronously as each person completes their verification.
events.capability_scope_rationale: Published by CAP-005 (SVC-050); consumed by CAP-002 (SVC-005 — updates verification_status) and CAP-005 intra-capability (SVC-014 — triggers individual CDD screening) and CAP-007 (SVC-017 — updates verification status dashboard).

payload_schema.individual_entity_id: string (UUID v4) — FK to DirectorRecord.director_id or UltimateBeneficialOwner.ubo_id
payload_schema.outcome: string enum (pass) — only pass outcomes trigger this event; fail outcomes trigger a separate exception flow
payload_schema.verified_first_name: string — name as extracted by verification vendor (CDD input for SVC-014 screening)
payload_schema.verified_nationality: array<string> — ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country codes (CDD input for SVC-014 screening)

events.compliance_note: Carries verified identity data (name, DOB, nationality) as CDD inputs for SVC-014 screening. Document number, biometric score, and address details are NOT included in the event payload (data minimisation). SVC-014 uses this payload as the input to PEP/sanctions/adverse media screening for the individual.

consumers.action: Updates DirectorRecord.verification_status or UltimateBeneficialOwner.verification_status to 'verified'. Tracks overall verification completeness — once all required individuals are verified, the application transitions to PH-143.
Triggers individual-level PEP/sanctions/adverse media screening for this person using verified identity data from the event payload. Updates UBO/director cdd_screening_result on completion.
Updates the identity verification status dashboard shown to PER-002. Decrements the 'pending' count and increments 'completed'.
Immutable audit log entry — director/UBO identity verification completion record

events.ordering_guarantees: Per-individual ordering: for a given individual_entity_id, events are strictly ordered. Across individuals in the same application, events may arrive in any order.
events.worm_rationale: Identity verification for directors and UBOs is an MLR 2017 Regulation 28(3) compliance obligation. The verification record is the bank's evidence of CDD compliance — retained for 5 years per MLR 2017 Regulation 40.

events.name: BusinessKYCCleared
events.trigger: SVC-014 has completed the full PH-143 CDD assessment: company-level PEP/sanctions/adverse media screening is complete (all clear); all director and UBO individual screenings are complete (all clear); sector risk and jurisdictional risk assessment complete; risk_category determined; EDD not required (or EDD required and MLRO has signed off via AP-B001). The BusinessKycAssessment entity has been created with the final assessment outcome.
events.capability_scope_rationale: Published by CAP-005 (SVC-014); consumed by CAP-002 (SVC-005 — gates PH-144 account decision) and CAP-007 (SVC-017 — notifies customer of CDD completion).

payload_schema.risk_category: string enum (standard | standard_elevated) — 'enhanced' would have triggered BusinessKYCReferralRaised instead
payload_schema.edd_required: boolean (always false in this event — EDD cases produce BusinessKYCReferralRaised)
payload_schema.next_review_date: string (ISO 8601 date) — next pKYC review date calculated from risk_category
payload_schema.assessor: string enum (automated | manual) — manual if MLRO EDD sign-off was required

events.compliance_note: Risk score, individual screening results, PEP status, and sanctions details are NOT included in the payload. These are MLRO-only data, protected by the tipping-off prohibition (POCA 2002 s333A) and the data classification policy. Consumers receive only the clearance fact and the risk_category.

consumers.action: This event is the gate for PH-144. On receipt, SVC-005 runs the automated account decision engine. Without BusinessKYCCleared, SVC-005 will not run the decision engine (MLR 2017 Regulation 28: no business relationship before CDD complete).
Transitions the UI from 'compliance checks in progress' holding state to 'account decision pending'. Notifies PER-002 that checks are complete.
Immutable audit log entry — KYC clearance for business customer
Archives the clearance event for 5 years per MLR 2017 Regulation 40

events.ordering_guarantees: Strictly ordered after all DirectorVerified events for the same application_id.
events.worm_rationale: KYC clearance is a regulatory event under MLR 2017. The fact that CDD was completed and cleared must be auditable for 5 years post-relationship end. The event itself does not contain sensitive screening data — only the clearance outcome.
events.retention: 5 years post-relationship end (WORM audit pipeline — SVC-111)

events.name: BusinessAccountOpened
events.trigger: SVC-005 creates the BusinessAccount entity at PH-145 following an approved BusinessApplicationDecisionMade event. Account number and sort code allocated from the commercial banking range. IBAN and BIC computed. BusinessCustomer.status promoted to 'active'.
events.capability_scope_rationale: Published by CAP-002 (SVC-005); consumed by CAP-007 (SVC-017 — renders account details to PER-002) and CAP-005 (SVC-014 — initiates pKYC monitoring).

payload_schema.sort_code: string — sort code in XX-XX-XX format

consumers.action: Renders the account details confirmation screen to PER-002 with sort code, account number, IBAN, and BIC
Immutable audit log entry — account opening record
Archives the account opening event for the duration of the relationship + 7 years

events.ordering_guarantees: Strictly ordered after BusinessApplicationDecisionMade (approved) for the same business_customer_id.
events.worm_rationale: Account opening is a regulated event. The account opening record must be retained for the duration of the customer relationship plus 7 years post-closure.
events.retention: Duration of relationship + 7 years (WORM audit pipeline — SVC-111)

events.name: BusinessAccountProvisioned
events.trigger: BusinessAccount.status transitions to 'active' and the multi-signatory configuration (authorised users, payment approval threshold, payment rails) has been written to the account. Published immediately after BusinessAccountOpened in the same provisioning transaction.
events.capability_scope_rationale: Published by CAP-002 (SVC-005); consumed by CAP-007 (SVC-017 — enables business portal setup) and CAP-005 (SVC-014 — activates pKYC ongoing monitoring).

payload_schema.payment_rails_enabled: array<string> enum values: bacs | fps | chaps | sepa

consumers.action: Receives the provisioned configuration to set up the business portal with the correct payment approval workflow and multi-user access configuration. Triggers PH-146 digital channel activation setup.
Activates ongoing pKYC monitoring for the BusinessCustomer: adverse media monitoring, Companies House officer change monitoring, and sanctions list continuous monitoring for all directors and UBOs.
Immutable audit log entry — account provisioning completion with configuration record

events.ordering_guarantees: Strictly ordered after BusinessAccountOpened for the same business_account_id.
events.worm_rationale: Account provisioning configuration is an operational record. Retained alongside account opening record.
events.retention: Duration of relationship + 7 years (WORM audit pipeline — SVC-111)

event_id_registry.note: BusinessKYCReferralRaised (EDD path) and BusinessSanctionsHitDetected are published by SVC-014 as exception events and are catalogued here by reference to the service-boundaries.json definitions. BusinessApplicationDecisionMade and BusinessDigitalChannelActivated are published by SVC-005 and SVC-017 respectively and follow the same pattern as EVT-175/B007 above.
